test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All chairs are tables.

Some tables are beds.

Conclusions:

(I) All beds are chairs.

(II) Some tables are chairs.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eedb9e038b0fd214028dfd509d1f1ec0b857299ef128e825d979d47e1dbfce84.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All beds are chairs → Does not follow (As all chairs are tables and some tables are beds. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some tables are chairs → Follow (As all chairs are tables. As whole chairs comes in tables, therefore it is possible.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
